## Problem and resulting behavior

What concrete trigger changes, and how will a user observe it? Link the affected requirement/specification and active plan slice.

## Hypothesis and design

Expected benefit, simplest alternative, and why this scope is sufficient. Explain new dependencies/preview features and consequential ADRs.

## Verification

Actual commands/tests and results. Distinguish offline fixtures, live smoke runs and statistical evaluations. Note missing verification; do not claim planned checks passed.

## Critical review

Concrete findings, corrections and remaining risks. Link the review record for substantial changes. Address capability/effort semantics, budgets, retries/effects, continuation, cancellation, privacy and API/CLI aesthetics where relevant.

## Documentation and scope

Updated specs/ADRs/plan, compatibility impacts and next slice. No credentials/private payloads. Mark experimental behavior explicitly.
